So this is my 2nd attempt of contacting you. I reached out Friday at 12pm
eastern time requesting an update on my order. It is now Tuesday 3:30 pm
eastern time and I have not heard back from you. You email states that
during normal business hours that a quick response should be exspected. I
have been back on your website several times since then looking for updated
status on my order group. It still does not show my purchased bundle deal
for any type of shipping update. It does show Nexus S1 in transit and the
Nexus L1 does not appear at all on the shipping update page. Few weeks ago
the S1 was in stock and waiting for L1 which was in transit to warehouse to
deliver before they would ship out together. Now the Nexus S1 is preparing
and the Nexus L1 doesnt show at all. I need an update as to what is going
on hear. Please contact ma as soon as possible.

James S.
(email hidden)
Handed to the team · Order is 49 days old with no ship date stamped; needs a confirmed S1 batch arriv

Hi James,

First, I'm sorry you wrote on Friday and heard nothing back. That shouldn't have happened, and I'm sorry too that nobody has explained where this order stands.

Here is the real picture on Shop···· (Nexus S1 and Nexus L1, placed August 19). Your L1 is sitting reserved at our Chattanooga warehouse with your name on it. The S1 is the one we're waiting on: that batch is still in transit to the US warehouse and is running behind. The two ship together in one box, so the order moves the moment the S1 stock lands and is checked in. That's also why the pairing looks flipped to you on the status page compared with a few weeks ago.

I won't give you a date I can't stand behind. Your order carries no stamped ship date, so I've put it in front of Abel and Georges to confirm exactly when that S1 batch lands, and one of them is picking it up today with a straight answer to you by email. You can also follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

For the wait and the silence, I've made you a code for a future order, HD-••••••, $50 off, yours alone, valid on orders over $200.

Our emails have been landing in junk for some customers lately, so it's worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts, since tracking and the update will come to this address.

Thanks for your patience, James.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
